description: Eight-channel stereo mixer with a pan, a mute, a solo and a level CV on every channel, and a master fader

params.text: Sets the level of the whole mix, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at 0dB
Sets the level of that channel, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at 0dB, the gain being the square of the fader position
Pans that channel between the two outputs; at the centre both outputs carry it at full level, and moving it to one side attenuates the far output while the near one stays full
Switches that channel in and out of the mix, the level ramping over about five samples rather than jumping
Solos that channel; while any solo on the module is on, only soloed channels reach the outputs

inputs.text: The signal for that channel, read as a single monophonic voltage
Voltage control of that channel's level: the channel is multiplied by this voltage divided by 10, so 10V passes it at the fader setting and 0V silences it

outputs.text: The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix

notes: each channel carries a text field for a name; click it and type, and what you type is saved with the patch
menu: DC block — puts a DC blocking filter on each channel
